item.description: “You have to be disciplined to win.” Indian women’s hockey coach Sjoerd Marijne reflects on the team’s historic Asian Games 2026 gold medal in an exclusive conversation with Shivani Gupta.India defeated defending champions China 1-0 in the final to win the women’s hockey gold for the first time since 1982, ending a 44-year wait. The victory also secured India a direct qualification spot for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics.Marijne has highlighted discipline, team unity, strong defence, hard work and competition for places as key elements of the team’s transformation.
